object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Over MCP, review (a) a suspect link whose target's description was tightened after the acknowledged commit; (b) an OK link; (c) an OK link whose target has an uncommitted description change. Expected: (a) the description at the acknowledged commit lacks the tightening and the current description has it; (b) both descriptions are equal; (c) the current description is the working copy's text.
